<translate>
The '''Giant Turtle''' is a harmless beach dweller of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. It never attacks, and it is the main source of '''Turtle Scales'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning ==

Giant Turtles spawn on beaches, on sand no higher than 4 blocks above sea level (spawn weight 8, groups of 1–2). They come in three shell variants.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior ==

The Giant Turtle is passive: it wanders and swims, and panics when hurt.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops ==

* 1 '''Raw Giant Turtle''' (cooks if on fire, +0–1 Looting)
* 1–2 '''Turtle Scale''' (+0–1 Looting)

Turtle Scales can also be crafted from a vanilla Scute. They are used for the '''Katchin Sprout''' and the yellow [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|capsule]] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Items|Items]]).
</translate>
